data.title: 奥萝拉 · 异界夜市的苹果糖香
data.description: 灯火璀璨的热闹异域夜市小吃街上。热气蒸腾，人潮熙攘。奥萝拉裹着风衣，双手捧着裹着透明糖浆的苹果糖咬下一小口，眼睛亮晶晶地偏过头看向身旁的席德，流露出重获自由漫步人间的新奇与快活。
data.location: bustling night market alley filled with food stall lanterns, steam, and colorful carnival lights
data.action: walking along market stalls, holding a shiny red candied apple on a wooden stick with both hands, looking over with sparkling joyful eyes
data.lighting: warm festive red and gold paper lantern lights reflecting in glossy candied apple
data.mood: delightful worldly rebirth, sweet lively companionship, vibrant festive joy
data.promptProse: Aurora in a stylish camel trench coat strolls through a vibrant night market, eating a red candied apple with lively sparkling eyes.
data.animaCaption: Aurora enjoying a candied apple on a lively evening festival date in a warm trench coat.
